Runs assembler recipes up to two tiers above the highest energy hatch. Required EU is still consumed.
Locks a failed recipe and retries without consuming more materials. Every attempt consumes EU; only a successful attempt produces outputs.
Starts at 0%. Each failure adds 33 percentage points at the same tier, 7.4 at +1, or 4.4 at +2. Lower-tier recipes always succeed immediately.
Each overclock uses 4x EU/t and 0.67x duration. Success resets the recorded recipe, failures and chance.
gtcsolo.prototype.locked: Retrying the recorded recipe. Locked until successful.
gtcsolo.prototype.output_wait: Prototype succeeded. Waiting for output space.
gtcsolo.prototype.voltage_required: The recorded recipe requires a suitable energy hatch tier.
